items.name: Readability
items.evidence: Adds one line with a short comment, '# Ensure base table is in aliases.', and the formatting matches the surrounding code.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: Reuses the existing helper query.get_initial_alias() inside single_alias. No duplicated logic, no dead code, no backend-specific branches. Identical to the reference fix.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: Fixes the root cause without special-casing. get_initial_alias() is idempotent, so filtered and joined deletes are unaffected. Hidden tests pass (F2P 1/1, P2P 52/52).

items.name: Subquery dropped only for genuine single-table deletes
items.name_zh: 仅在真正单表删除时去掉子查询
items.evidence: The base alias is registered in single_alias before aliases are counted, so joined deletes still count >1 and keep the pk__in subquery. The MySQL compiler, which also checks single_alias, benefits too. Verified output: 'DELETE FROM "auth_permission"'.
